title: Goo Tabs
description: Tabs whose indicator travels like liquid: it stretches mid-flight, then settles over the chosen tab.
usage: A working tab set — buttons, panels, arrow keys — whose indicator refuses to move like a spreadsheet. It slides with an elastic curve and stretches a fifth wider mid-journey, which is all the goo a production interface can defend. The panels are real panels; switch the content, keep the plumbing.
a11y: Full tab semantics: role=tablist, aria-selected, one tab stop, arrow-key travel — the liquid never touches the keyboard model. Under prefers-reduced-motion the indicator jumps without stretching, still landing exactly where it belongs.
